# The IMAP AddSubfolder change removes a notification at that construction boundary

1575 removes NotifyFolderAdded from nsImapMailFolder.AddSubfolder while the accepted function still sets parent/flags, appends the child and returns it. Do not infer that all IMAP folder-add notifications disappeared or that every caller already notifies at the right time; only this construction boundary was checked and the bug’s event-order diagnosis remains pending. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/imap/src.
